rachel_cs: Onboarding note: Horizon POC seeing quick 401s then a rapid 429 spike during SDK warmup. Starts ~20s after first cold invocations. Can eng triage?
dan_eng: thanks. Typical pattern is ephemeral token rotation + warmup fanout. Do we have a sample request?
rachel_cs: sample from their serverless warmup:
```
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral>
{"model":"rwd-embed-2b","input":"warmup"}
```
arun_se: hypothesis: their auth service rotates tokens every 25s and multiple warmup threads race. A few requests present an invalid/empty header (401), then retries/concurrency hit our soft per-key window -> 429.
dan_eng: short-term fixes for them: 1) cache token per worker for 70-90s, 2) add jittered backoff on 401s, 3) reduce warmup parallelism (try 3). Example JS config to send: 
```
const c = new RedwoodClient({tokenProvider: cachedProvider, maxConcurrency:3, authRetry:{attempts:3, baseDelayMs:200, jitter:true}})
```
ops-bot: metric alert: horizon-poc key (hzn-77) 5m 429 rate rose 2% -> 39% at 3360001144. Top route: /v1/embeddings.
ardan_eng: if they can't ship change fast we can request ops to temporarily bump soft concurrency + enable 30s token-grace for hzn-77. Need ops approval.
claire_ae: FYI this is high priority POC; renewal discussion in 3 weeks. If onboarding stalled >48h escalate to AE team.
rachel_cs: plan: send SDK snippet now, request they deploy to staging and run 40 sequential warmups. Re-evaluate 20m after. If 429 rate >25% escalate to ops for temporary cap. Action owners: Rachel -> customer note & call; Dan -> ops escalation template; Arun -> small debounce doc.
